## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #213, final round 2, at **028d340f8e4dcb51c9e44aff4247891c0e9cf7d7**, reviewing the delta from `38fa067782317f1154a0aaf47c4319d4180e32d5` under C33/C34.

**S213-001 is closed for the reviewed Unix paths.** New reply/command artifacts are private from creation rather than relying on a private macOS TMPDIR or exit cleanup.

| Repair | Source evidence |
|---|---|
| Stop script | `harness/scripts/claude-stop-pij.sh:14,35-45,67-80`: `umask 077` precedes `mktemp -d`; reply, answer and stderr are created inside that private directory as owner-only files. EXIT cleanup targets only the successfully created, quoted work directory. Child error logging and answer forwarding remain. |
| Display progress | `crates/cli/src/claude_display.rs:189-242`: directory creation/tightening to 0700 occurs before writing; the temporary file is exclusively created as 0600, written, then atomically renamed. Errors return before insecure writing and attempt temporary-file cleanup. |
| Existing lax state | Directory tightening protects existing/abandoned files. Rewriting replaces the old message file with a new 0600 file; this is not a blanket chmod of every existing file. Aborted state may remain, but behind the private directory. |
| Naming and boundaries | IDs remain bounded to 128 ASCII alphanumeric/`-`/`_` bytes (`claude_display.rs:154-160,259-272`). No new path traversal, caller-context or presentation-boundary change was identified. |

The Stop test asserts a 0700 directory, three 0600 files and empty temporary storage after exit (`crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs:2930-2953`). The display test verifies persisted hidden text, owner-only modes, and tightening an existing 0755 directory (`crates/cli/src/claude_display.rs:433-460`).
